extraction_target_summary: Three Scrapy subsystems (download middlewares, spider middlewares, item pipelines) plus the shared MiddlewareManager framework. The 'common component' to extract is the scrapy.middleware.MiddlewareManager machinery: instantiation from settings, method-chaining across middleware instances, and the open_spider/from_crawler/spider_opened lifecycle hooks. What stays in each file: the algorithm-specific decision logic (e.g., Retry's exponential backoff, Depth's counter, FilesPipeline's media download).

subsystems.name: downloadermiddlewares
subsystems.interface: process_request(request, spider) / process_response(request, response, spider) / process_exception(request, exception, spider)

subsystems.name: spidermiddlewares
subsystems.interface: process_spider_input(response, spider) / process_spider_output(response, result, spider) / process_spider_exception(response, exception, spider)

subsystems.name: pipelines
subsystems.interface: process_item(item, spider) (returns Item / DropItem / raises DropItem)

subsystems.name: middleware_framework
subsystems.interface: MiddlewareManager + MiddlewareMixin — base for all three subsystem manager classes

common_component_hints: MiddlewareManager (in scrapy_middleware.py) — chains middlewares, instantiates from settings
MiddlewareMixin — the common base mixin all three subsystems derive their managers from
from_crawler(cls, crawler) classmethod — every middleware/pipeline defines this to receive the crawler
open_spider / close_spider hooks — used by 11 of 13 download middlewares
spider attribute / crawler.settings.get() pattern — settings access convention
verification: All 56 source + test files verified byte-identical (md5) with upstream Scrapy at commit 3c6a62db4.
